CFA: the soil plug supports the bore
The soil plug remaining on the auger supports the wall of the bore; no separate support is needed. Fast, low in noise and vibration; an automatic record is made for every pile.
In fine sand below the groundwater a CFA pile needs particular care (it is not even recommended in loose, flowing soil): control of drilling and concrete pressure is critical.
